ucs.title: [LLM] Secret Blizzard (Turla) ComRAT v4 — Gmail Web UI used as covert C2 channel
ucs.description: Hunts ComRAT v4 (a.k.a. Agent.BTZ successor, tracked as Turla/Secret Blizzard/Snake) which is unique among APT C2s for embedding command retrieval inside the Gmail web interface — a non-browser process loads WinINet/COM components and scrapes mail.google.com / inbox.google.com using stolen session cookies to receive commands hidden in mail bodies and attachments. Detects the signature of a non-browser binary speaking to Gmail's web endpoints under a real user identity.
ucs.splunk:
| tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Web.url) as urls values(Web.http_user_agent) as uas from datamodel=Web where (Web.dest IN ("mail.google.com","inbox.google.com","accounts.google.com","apis.google.com") OR Web.url="*mail.google.com*" OR Web.url="*inbox.google.com*") by host, Web.user, Web.app, Web.dest
| `drop_dm_object_name(Web)`
| where NOT match(lower(app),"^(chrome|firefox|msedge|brave|opera|iexplore|safari|msedgewebview2|googlechrome)\.exe$")
| where NOT match(lower(app),"(thunderbird|outlook|hxoutlook|olk)\.exe$")
| where NOT match(user,"(?i)^(system|local service|network service|.*\$)$")
| convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime)
| sort - lastTime
ucs.kql:
let LookbackDays = 14d;
let GmailEndpoints = dynamic(["mail.google.com","inbox.google.com","accounts.google.com","apis.google.com","www.googleapis.com"]);
let Browsers = dynamic(["chrome.exe","msedge.exe","firefox.exe","brave.exe","opera.exe","iexplore.exe","safari.exe","msedgewebview2.exe","chromium.exe"]);
let MailClients = dynamic(["outlook.exe","thunderbird.exe","hxoutlook.exe","olk.exe"]);
DeviceNetworkEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
| where isnotempty(RemoteUrl)
| where RemoteUrl has_any (GmailEndpoints)
| where InitiatingProcessFileName !in~ (Browsers)
| where InitiatingProcessFileName !in~ (MailClients)
| where InitiatingProcessAccountName !endswith "$"
| where InitiatingProcessAccountName !in~ ("system","local service","network service")
| where InitiatingProcessFolderPath !startswith @"C:\Program Files"
   and InitiatingProcessFolderPath !startswith @"C:\Program Files (x86)"
| summarize HitCount = count(),
            FirstSeen = min(Timestamp),
            LastSeen = max(Timestamp),
            UniqueUrls = dcount(RemoteUrl),
            SampleCmd = any(InitiatingProcessCommandLine),
            SampleSha = any(InitiatingProcessSHA256)
            by DeviceName, InitiatingProcessAccountName, InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessFolderPath
| where HitCount >= 3              // beacon-like cadence, not one-off
| order by LastSeen desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let LookbackDays = 14d;
let Browsers = dynamic(["chrome.exe","msedge.exe","firefox.exe","brave.exe","opera.exe","iexplore.exe","safari.exe","msedgewebview2.exe"]);
let GmailHits =
    ImWebSession
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where Url has_any ("mail.google.com","inbox.google.com","accounts.google.com","apis.google.com")
    | project TimeGenerated, SrcHostname, SrcUsername, Url, HttpRequestHeaderUserAgent, DstHostname;
let SuspectProcs =
    ImProcessCreate
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where ActingProcessName !endswith_cs "chrome.exe"
        and ActingProcessName !endswith_cs "msedge.exe"
        and ActingProcessName !endswith_cs "firefox.exe"
        and ActingProcessName !endswith_cs "outlook.exe"
    | where ActingProcessCommandLine has_any ("wininet","winhttp","InternetOpen","google.com","gmail")
        or ActingProcessName !contains ".exe"
    | project ProcTime=TimeGenerated, DvcHostname, ActorUsername, ActingProcessName, ActingProcessCommandLine;
GmailHits
| join kind=inner (SuspectProcs) on $left.SrcHostname == $right.DvcHostname
| where abs(datetime_diff('minute', TimeGenerated, ProcTime)) <= 5
| summarize FirstSeen=min(TimeGenerated), LastSeen=max(TimeGenerated), Hits=count(), UniqueUrls=dcount(Url) by SrcHostname, SrcUsername, ActingProcessName, ActingProcessCommandLine
| where Hits >= 3
ucs.datadog_query: (source:windows.sysmon @EventID:3 AND @Image:(*\powershell.exe OR *\PowerShell.exe OR *\POWERSHELL.EXE OR *\rundll32.exe OR *\RunDll32.exe OR *\regsvr32.exe OR *\RegSvr32.exe OR *\mshta.exe OR *\MSHTA.EXE OR *\wscript.exe OR *\WScript.exe OR *\cscript.exe OR *\CScript.exe OR *\svchost.exe OR *\SvcHost.exe) AND @DestinationHostname:(mail.google.com OR inbox.google.com OR accounts.google.com OR apis.google.com)) AND -@User:(*$ OR SYSTEM OR LOCAL\ SERVICE OR NETWORK\ SERVICE)
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=DnsRequest
| DomainName=/mail\.google\.com|inbox\.google\.com|accounts\.google\.com|apis\.google\.com/i
| NOT ContextImageFileName=/\\(chrome|msedge|firefox|brave|opera|iexplore|safari|msedgewebview2|chromium|outlook|thunderbird|hxoutlook|olk)\.exe$/i
| NOT ContextImageFileName=/\\(svchost|services|RuntimeBroker|backgroundTaskHost)\.exe$/i
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, ContextImageFileName, DomainName], function=[count(), min(@timestamp), max(@timestamp), count(field=DomainName, distinct=true, as=UniqueDomains)])
| _count >= 3
| sort(_count, order=desc)
ucs.rationale: ComRAT v4's Gmail-web-UI C2 is a Turla-only tradecraft signature documented by ESET (May 2020), CISA AA20-352A and Microsoft (Secret Blizzard reporting). No other tracked APT abuses the Gmail web interface this way — they use Gmail SMTP/IMAP, not the browser-cookie scraped HTML inbox. ucs.title: [LLM] Secret Blizzard (Turla) 'Snake' implant — kernel driver service install with random-name pattern
ucs.description: Hunts the installation phase of the Snake/Uroburos kernel-mode rootkit (Turla's flagship implant — see CISA/FBI/NSA Operation MEDUSA, AA23-129A, May 2023). Snake registers its kernel driver as a Windows service under HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services with a short, random-looking alphanumeric service name and an ImagePath pointing to a .sys file in System32\drivers — distinct from legitimate driver installs which use vendor names and are written by services.exe/TrustedInstaller/msiexec.
ucs.splunk:
| tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Registry.registry_value_data) as image_path values(Registry.process_name) as installer from datamodel=Endpoint.Registry where Registry.registry_path="*\\SYSTEM\\CurrentControlSet\\Services\\*\\ImagePath" Registry.registry_value_data="*.sys" by host, Registry.user, Registry.registry_path
| `drop_dm_object_name(Registry)`
| rex field=registry_path "Services\\\\(?<service_name>[^\\\\]+)\\\\ImagePath"
| where match(service_name,"^[A-Za-z0-9]{6,14}$")
| where NOT match(service_name,"(?i)^(intel|amd|nvidia|realtek|microsoft|usbstor|tcpip|netbt|http|srv|mssecflt|wdfilter|sense|mpfilter|bam|dam)")
| where match(image_path,"(?i)(\\\\system32\\\\drivers\\\\|\\\\drivers\\\\)")
| where NOT match(lower(installer),"^(services\.exe|msiexec\.exe|trustedinstaller\.exe|drvinst\.exe|setupapi.*)$")
| convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime)
| sort - lastTime
ucs.kql:
let LookbackDays = 30d;
let KnownInstallers = dynamic(["services.exe","msiexec.exe","trustedinstaller.exe","drvinst.exe","setup.exe","wusa.exe"]);
let KnownPrefixes = dynamic(["intel","amd","nvidia","realtek","microsoft","usbstor","http","srv","tcpip","netbt","mssecflt","wdfilter","sense","mpfilter","bam","dam","mrxsmb","vmware","vbox"]);
DeviceRegistryEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
| where ActionType in ("RegistryValueSet","RegistryKeyCreated")
| where RegistryKey has @"SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\"
| where RegistryValueName =~ "ImagePath"
| where RegistryValueData endswith ".sys"
| extend ServiceName = extract(@"Services\\([^\\]+)\\", 1, RegistryKey)
| where ServiceName matches regex @"^[A-Za-z0-9]{6,14}$"
| where not(ServiceName has_any (KnownPrefixes))
| where RegistryValueData has_any (@"\System32\drivers\", @"\drivers\")
| where InitiatingProcessFileName !in~ (KnownInstallers)
| where InitiatingProcessAccountName !endswith "$" or InitiatingProcessFileName !in~ ("services.exe","system")
| join kind=leftouter (
    DeviceImageLoadEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where FolderPath has @"\System32\drivers\"
    | project DeviceId, DriverPath = strcat(FolderPath, FileName), DriverSha = SHA256, LoadTime = Timestamp
  ) on DeviceId
| where DriverPath =~ RegistryValueData or isempty(DriverPath)
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, InitiatingProcessAccountName, ServiceName, ImagePath = RegistryValueData, Installer = InitiatingProcessFileName, InstallerCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine, DriverSha, LoadTime
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let LookbackDays = 30d;
let KnownPrefixes = dynamic(["intel","amd","nvidia","realtek","microsoft","usbstor","http","srv","tcpip","netbt","mssecflt","wdfilter","sense","mpfilter","bam","dam","mrxsmb","vmware","vbox"]);
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
| where EventID == 4697   // A service was installed in the system
| where isnotempty(ServiceName) and isnotempty(ServiceFileName)
| where ServiceFileName endswith ".sys"
| where ServiceFileName has_any (@"\System32\drivers\", @"\drivers\")
| where ServiceName matches regex "^[A-Za-z0-9]{6,14}$"
| where not(ServiceName has_any (KnownPrefixes))
| where ServiceStartType in ("1","2","SERVICE_SYSTEM_START","SERVICE_AUTO_START","Boot","System","Auto")
| where SubjectUserName !endswith "$" or SubjectUserName !in~ ("SYSTEM")
   or ProcessName !endswith "services.exe"
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, SubjectUserName, SubjectDomainName, ServiceName, ServiceFileName, ServiceStartType, ServiceAccount, ProcessName, ParentProcessName
| order by TimeGenerated desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: Turla Snake Kernel Driver Service Installation
id: 7c2f4a91-8b15-4f7e-9a3d-1c5e8b2f4a92
status: experimental
description: Detects installation of a Windows service backed by a kernel driver (.sys in System32\drivers) whose service name matches the short random alphanumeric pattern used by Turla's Snake/Uroburos implant. CISA AA23-129A (Operation MEDUSA).
references:
  - https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/cybersecurity-advisories/aa23-129a
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/05/25
logsource:
  category: registry_set
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_path:
    TargetObject|contains: '\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\'
    TargetObject|endswith: '\ImagePath'
  selection_sys:
    Details|endswith: '.sys'
  selection_drivers:
    Details|contains:
      - '\System32\drivers\'
      - '\drivers\'
  filter_known_installer:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\services.exe'
      - '\msiexec.exe'
      - '\TrustedInstaller.exe'
      - '\drvinst.exe'
  filter_known_prefix:
    TargetObject|contains:
      - '\Services\Intel'
      - '\Services\AMD'
      - '\Services\NVIDIA'
      - '\Services\Microsoft'
      - '\Services\Realtek'
      - '\Services\WdFilter'
      - '\Services\Sense'
  condition: all of selection_* and not 1 of filter_*
fields:
  - TargetObject
  - Details
  - Image
  - User
falsepositives:
  - Third-party driver installs not using stock Windows installers
  - Custom in-house kernel drivers
level: high
tags:
  - attack.persistence
  - attack.defense_evasion
  - attack.t1543.003
  - attack.t1547.006
  - attack.t1014
  - detection.turla
  - detection.secret_blizzard
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.security @EventID:4697 @ServiceFileName:(*\drivers\*.sys OR *\Drivers\*.sys OR *\DRIVERS\*.sys OR *\System32\drivers\*.sys) -@ServiceName:(Intel* OR AMD* OR NVIDIA* OR Microsoft* OR Realtek* OR WdFilter OR Sense* OR MpFilter OR usbstor OR vmware* OR VBox*) -@ProcessName:(*\services.exe OR *\msiexec.exe OR *\TrustedInstaller.exe OR *\drvinst.exe)
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=AsepValueUpdate
| RegObjectName=/\\SYSTEM\\CurrentControlSet\\Services\\[A-Za-z0-9]{6,14}\\?$/i
| RegValueName=ImagePath
| RegStringValue=/\\(System32\\)?drivers\\[^\\]+\.sys$/i
| NOT RegObjectName=/\\Services\\(Intel|AMD|NVIDIA|Microsoft|Realtek|WdFilter|Sense|MpFilter|usbstor|vmware|VBox|mrxsmb|tcpip|netbt|http|srv)/i
| NOT ContextImageFileName=/\\(services|msiexec|TrustedInstaller|drvinst|setup)\.exe$/i
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, RegObjectName, RegStringValue, ContextImageFileName], function=[count(), min(@timestamp), max(@timestamp)])
| sort(_min, order=desc)
ucs.rationale: The Snake/Uroburos kernel driver is the foundational Turla implant going back to 2003 — Operation MEDUSA (FBI 2023) called it 'the most sophisticated cyber espionage tool in the FSB's arsenal'. Snake's loader registers the kernel driver as a service with a short random ASCII name (no vendor branding) under HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services and points ImagePath at a fresh .sys in System32\driv
